အမှန်တရား။ တထာဂတ-（၁）-ကြည့်။
DOP: tatha mfn. and n. [ cf tathā; perhaps extracted from tathatā, tathatta], 1. ( mfn. ) true, real ; D I 190, 9 (samaṇo Gotamo bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ ~aṃ paṭipadaṃ paññāpeti); Sn 1115 (etaṃ ñāṇaṃ ~aṃ); Ja IV 164, 15´ (idam eva seṭṭhaṃ ~aṃ saccan ti); Nidd I 76, 8 (idaṃ saccaṃ tacchaṃ ~aṃ bhūtaṃ yāthāvaṃ aviparītan ti; Nidd-a I 205, 16 : ~an ti vipariṇāmarahitaṃ); 287, 4 (vādo katamo sacco taccho ~o bhūto …); Cp 1:8:5 (~aṃ nu vitathaṃ n’ etaṃ handa vīmaṃsayāmi taṃ; Cp-a 65, 2 : saccaṃ nu kho udāhu asaccan ti attho); Mil 203, 22 (yaṃ mayā bhaṇitaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ ~aṃ udāhu vitathan ti); Sv 65, 21 (~o avitatho anaññatho); — 2. ( n. ) truth ; D III 171, 12* (bhūtena tacchena ~ena tosayi); S V 430, 22 foll. (cattār’ imāni bhikkhave ~āni avitathāni anaññathāni); Sv 65, 18 (~ānaṃ abhisambuddhattā tathāgato ti vuccati); — tathato, truly; as the truth ; Ja IV 73, 12 (idaṃ maṅgalan ti ~ato na jāniṃsu, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee tatvato); 201, 10 (~ato ñatvā, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee tatvato); Sv 72, 21 (atathaṃ vatthuṃ ~ato paraṃ viññāpetukāmassa); Ps II 113, 5 (thetato ti tathato); Ap-a 420, 21 (taṃ ~ato ñatvā); — °- tā , f. ,, °- tta , n. ,, see sv tathā ; — °- dassi(n) , tathādassi(n), mfn. , seeing what is really so ; Sv 65, 29 foll. (kathaṃ ~-tāya tathāgato) = Ps I 49, 29 foll. ≠ Bv-a 16, 23 foll. ; It-a II 189, 28 (tathādassibhāvato); Bv-a 16, 31* (tathākārena yo dhamme jānāti anupassati ~ī ti sambuddho tasmā vutto tathāgato); — °- dhamma , m. [tatha + dhamma 1 ], a truth ; Sv 65, 13 foll. (kathaṃ ~e yāthāvato abhisambuddho ti tathāgato, ~ā nāma cattāri ariyasaccāni); It-a II 37, 6 (yathā ca te ~e dukkhādayo aviparītato abbhaññiṃsu, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee tathā dhamme); Th-a II 117, 26 (yathā ca rūpārūpadhammānaṃ tathalakkhaṇaṃ ~e ca ariyasaccāni āgatā adhigatā avabuddhā tathā ime pī ti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee tathādhamme); — °- lakkhaṇa , n. , the true distinguishing mark, the true characteristic ;? Sp 146, 8 (phalaṃ pana nirodhassa ~aṃ upanijjhāyatī ti lakkhaṇūpanijjhānan ti vuccati, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee tathā-) = Nidd-a I 130, 17 ≠ As 167, 17 ( Be, Ce, Se so; Ee tattha lakkhaṇaṃ); Sv 65, 10 (nibbānassa pariyosānalakkhaṇaṃ tathaṃ avitathaṃ, evaṃ ~aṃ ñāṇagatiyā āgato … ti tathāgato); It-a II 37, 5 (yathā vā te khandhādīnaṃ ~aṃ yāthāvato paṭivijjhiṃsu, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee tathā-); — °- vādi(n) , tathāvādi(n), mfn. , speaking what is so, speaking the truth ; Kv 65, 4 (nanu bhagavā saccavādī kālavādī bhūtavādī ~ī avitathavādī anaññathavādī ti); Sv 66, 13 (kathaṃ ~-tāya tathāgato) = Ps I 50, 13 foll. ( Se so; Be, Ce, Ee tathāvāditāya) ≠ Bv-a 17, 1 foll. ( Be, Se so; Ce, Ee tathāvāditāya); Bv-a 17, 12* (tathāvādī jino yasmā tathadhammappakāsako, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee tathāvādi … tathādhamma-); — atatha , mfn. , not true ; D II 64, 14 (~aṃ va pana santaṃ tathattāya upakappessāmī ti); M II 256, 14 (sammānibbānādhimutto ’ham asmī ti evaṃmāni assa ~aṃ samānaṃ, Be so; Ce evaṃmānī assa ~aṃ sa mānaṃ; Ee evaṃmānī atthaṃ samānaṃ; Se evamādi assa atthaṃ samānaṃ); Sv 72, 21 (~aṃ vatthuṃ tathato paraṃ viññāpetukāmassa); Vv-a 240, 28 (vitathan ti ~aṃ musā ti attho); — see also yathātathaṃ.
